title: Plexus: reproduce and improve original guide-discrimination AUROC
goal: Recreate and improve the original source Figure 4 guide-versus-non-targeting-control discrimination endpoint: complete guide-by-donor-by-fold AUROC outputs for Plexus and manual features in WT WTC11 and WT Patient strata, under the original source well-split and preprocessing protocol. Final-paper/archive equivalence remains unresolved. Reproduction and improvement are separate outcomes under paired paper+data versus paper+data+official-code conditions. Separately retained biological reproduction: the broader CRISPRi phenotypic and network-level gene-modifier findings and their source-defined controls. The previous 52-gene/four-line registration and prospective whole-plate extension remain historical, not implied coverage of the selected Figure 4 endpoint. Improved guide discrimination does not establish new biological gene discoveries.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable original-source analysis plus complete source-native performance panel, observation-level predictions, identities, folds, preprocessing/normalization operands, eligibility/skip diagnostics and mandatory source controls defined in primary-endpoint-v1/reproduction.v2.json.

Improvement: candidate predictions and complete matched-source performance vector assessed against the strongest relevant source author comparison under an independently justified full-panel policy. No invented scalar, effect-size maximization or selected-subset completion.

Separate provenance: Separately retained biological reproduction: the broader CRISPRi phenotypic and network-level gene-modifier findings and their source-defined controls. The previous 52-gene/four-line registration and prospective whole-plate extension remain historical, not implied coverage of the selected Figure 4 endpoint. Improved guide discrimination does not establish new biological gene discoveries.
success_criteria: Recreate the explicitly selected original method endpoint under the same source dataset, population, split, inputs, preprocessing, metric and full support, with justified independent numerical/uncertainty assessment.

Surpass the strongest relevant source-author method on that same complete performance endpoint only after author/reference calibration and an independently justified frozen panel/effect/uncertainty policy. Reproduction fidelity and genuine performance improvement are separate outcomes.

Retain source controls, null/saturated/normalization operands, eligibility and skipped/undefined cases as fidelity requirements; do not turn diagnostic or biological effect quantities into maximize targets.
Keep paper_data and paper_data_author_code results separate with identical common data/artifact exposure and budgets; official implementation access is the declared information difference.

All current scientific outcomes remain unknown and readiness false. Contracts and source components alone do not establish authentic local acceptance, AI performance, paper-relative improvement or current SOTA.
Preserve the previous biological scope and its root contracts as historical/separately named evidence. This explicit method-primary selection does not claim completion of that broader biology.
participant_inputs: Complete original processed neuronal observations and metadata for the source Figure 4 WT guide discrimination task. Before admission choose and pin one source-compatible representation/exposure profile: raw/processed-data reconstruction or explicitly assisted identical author embeddings/checkpoints; neither choice is currently frozen. Same complete original observations, source preprocessing/representation exposure profile and budgets in paper_data and paper_data_author_code. Original pre-split normalization exposure is disclosed and retained; only the latter adds pinned author implementation. Weights/embeddings are algorithm-bearing assistance: explicitly common and identical with provenance/training-overlap disclosure, or withheld from both. Hidden fitted reference predictions/score answers remain evaluator-held.
